issues.claim: Ellie Mental Health - Old Bridge (1405 Route 18, Suite 106 South) listed as a therapy clinic, flagged 'borderline on the franchise exclusion'
issues.problem: Excluded type: it is a franchise. Ellie Mental Health sells franchises; its own site describes locally owned clinics operating under Ellie's brand and systems (elliementalhealth.com/own-an-ellie). The mapper flagged it as borderline and kept it, which breaks the mapper's own 'no chains or franchises' rule.
issues.fix: Remove the entry. If a franchise-brand clinic is wanted, decide the rule first and apply it consistently (SWEAT440 and Powerhouse Gym are in the same position).

issues.claim: SWEAT440 Old Bridge (2030 US-9, Suite 101) listed as a boutique fitness studio

issues.fix: Remove the entry, or restate the exclusion rule so franchise-brand studios are handled one way across all zones.

issues.claim: NUVA Smile (3333 US-9 North) listed as a dental practice

issues.fix: Remove as a chain, or apply an explicit 'independent single/2-3 office practice only' test and re-screen Empire Dental Group, ProFysio, Dermatology Associates etc. against it.

issues.claim: Satori Academy of Martial Arts (1018 Route 9) listed as a martial arts studio

issues.fix: Remove as a regional chain under the mapper's stated chain rule.

issues.claim: Powerhouse Gym Old Bridge (1091 Route 9 North) listed as a gym with 'family-owned' local site
issues.problem: Franchise/licence brand: the location's own page offers 'travel benefits to over 300 of our clubs worldwide', and the brand describes 300+ licensed clubs in 39 states and 17 countries. A single licensed club of a national brand is the same category as SWEAT440/Ellie, which the rules exclude.
issues.fix: Decide explicitly: either the exclusion covers national license/franchise brands (then remove) or it only covers multi-outlet operators (then document that and re-check SWEAT440/Ellie the same way).

issues.claim: Old Bridge Dental, 125 County Rd 516, phone (732) 443-0714, '4.8-4.9 stars, 228 reviews'
issues.problem: The practice's own site gives a different phone number: (732) 967-2214, and its structured data listed streetAddress '125 Highway 516' with telephone '(732) 967-2214'. The site's schema also names Dental Care Alliance, LLC (a multi-state dental support organization, Sarasota FL) as the practice's parentOrganization, so this is a DSO-affiliated practice, not independent.
issues.fix: Replace the phone with (732) 967-2214 (or mark it disputed) and add a DSO-affiliation note, or drop the entry if DSO-affiliated practices count as chains.
